1.text: Uwiteka, ni iki kiguhagaritse kure?Ni iki gitumye wihisha mu bihe by'amakuba no mu by'ibyago?

2.text: Ubwibone bw'umunyabyaha bumutera kwirukanira umunyamubabaro cyane kumufata,Icyampa bagafatwa n'uburiganya batekereje.

3.text: Kuko umunyabyaha yihimbariza ibyo umutima we wifuza,Kandi umunyazi yimūra Uwiteka akamusuzugura.

4.text: Umunyabyaha nk'uko ubwibone bwo mu maso he buri,Aravuga ati “Ntazahōra.”Ibyo yibwira byose bihurira muri iri jambo ngo“Nta Mana iriho.”

5.text: Inzira ze zikomera iteka,Amateka yawe ari hejuru cyane aho atareba,Abanzi be bose abacurira ingoni.

6.text: Aribwira ati “Sinzanyeganyezwa,Kugeza ibihe byose sinzabona ibyago.”

7.text: Akanwa ke kuzuye imivumo n'uburinganya n'agahato,Munsi y'ururimi rwe hariho igomwa no gukiranirwa.

8.text: Yicara mu bico byo mu midugudu,Mu rwihisho yica abatariho urubanza,Amaso ye ayatatisha umunyamubabaro.

9.text: Yubikirira mu gico nk'uko intare yubikirira mu isenga ryayo,Yubikirira gufata umunyamubabaro,Kandi koko aramufata akamukururisha ikigoyi cye.

11.text: Aribwira ati “Imana yibagiwe,Ihishe mu maso hayo ntabwo izabireba.”

12.text: Uwiteka haguruka, Mana manika ukuboko kwawe,Ntiwibagirwe umunyamubabaro.

13.text: Ni iki gituma umunyabyaha asuzugura Imana,Akayibwirira mu mutima we ati “Ntuzahōra”?

14.text: Warabibonye kuko urebera igomwa n'urwango kubishyiraho ukuboko kwawe,Umunyamubabaro akwiringira wenyine,Ni wowe ujya utabara impfubyi.

15.text: Vunagura ukuboko k'umunyabyaha,Ushimikire ububi bw'umubi kugeza aho utazabumusanganira.

16.text: Uwiteka ni we Mwami iteka ryose,Abanyamahanga barimbukiye mu gihugu cye.

17.text: Uwiteka, wumvise ibyo abanyamubabaro bashaka,Uzakomeze imitima yabo, uzatyarize ugutwi,

18.text: Kugira ngo ucire impfubyi n'abahatwa imanza zibakwiriye,Umuntu wakomotse mu butaka ye kuzongera gutera ubwoba.
